title: When Ldaxr Doesn't Work: Exclusive Accesses and Cacheability on AArch64
summary: A technical deep-dive into Ldaxr (Load-Acquire Exclusive) instruction failures on AArch64 architecture, exploring the interaction between exclusive monitor operations and cacheability settings that can cause unexpected behavior in low-level systems code.
problem_solved: Explains why exclusive access instructions like LDXR/STXR may fail or behave unexpectedly due to cache configuration and memory attributes on ARM64 processors.
why_valuable: Provides critical understanding of ARM64 memory semantics for systems programmers writing lock-free code, mutexes, or other synchronization primitives.
